boundary: Installed Chrome extension artifact, distinct from @oai npm packages. @core/browser-extension is this project's package name; no claim of an original @oai/browser-extension package.
thirdParty: This inspected transport uses Chrome nativeMessaging/alarms and standard timers. Sentry 10.48.0 is separately bundled; not copied into the transport. Broader dependency audit remains pending.
remaining: Production command-handler dependency wiring (session wd, tab leases, request-header and CDP security, SIWC, overlay, mentions, initializers), manifest and build/install packaging; native messaging host executable remains external.
sharedImplementation: Browser-service to and extension fc share protocol methods but preserve their distinct transport-field initialization order. Core extraction and factory are project refactoring boundaries.
